sources.finding: Useful original executed transfer ground truth; file completions are not independent sessions. Reviewed DNS/exfil YAML files advertise Sysmon or PowerShell host logs, without a session/client/QTYPE/original-query timing join. Long-domain generation is not certified completed tunnelling. No log contents downloaded; no claim about every other Splunk dataset.

Producer schema documents DNS query/source/type/time fields and public data indexes, but reviewed pages provide no executed dnscat2/iodine session joins or the five independently attributed benign controls. ATT&CK T1048/T1071 and protocol tunnel logs alone do not prove DNS tunnelling. No CSV/Parquet rows opened.

Paper reports 870 sessions (70 attack/800 benign) but its reviewed links supply no actionable public dataset download or dnscat2/iodine/session-question join. Paper licence is not dataset permission. No data requested from authors.
